Emma (Sales): Hey team — Acme's SIG asked for our incident response / breach notification timelines. Can someone paste the canonical presales wording we should give?
Jordan (Solutions Eng): Which level of commitment are they asking for? regulatory or just 'how quickly do you tell customers'?
Emma (Sales): Both — they explicitly called out GDPR 72h and want to know if we will notify them and provide forensics/IOCs.
Sara (Security): Short answer: we can provide a standard, contract-negotiable clause for presales. Longer: we never act as the customer's legal notifier by default, but we will notify and assist. Here's a recommended snippet you can share (copy/paste):
```
Incident Notification (presales language):
- Redwood Inference will notify the designated customer security contact as soon as practicable and no later than 24 hours after Redwood confirms a security incident that materially affects customer data or service availability.
- For incidents involving personal data where regulatory notification may be required (e.g., GDPR), Redwood will promptly assist the customer in preparing reports to supervisory authorities and provide relevant technical details. Customers retain responsibility for regulator-facing filings unless Redwood is required by applicable law to make a direct notification.
- Redwood will provide an initial incident summary within 72 hours of confirmation, a technical incident report (including IOCs and mitigation steps) within 30 days, and a final post-incident report within 90 days, subject to complexity and legal constraints.
- Point of contact: security@redwood.com.
```
Sara (Security): Notes/caveats: 1) "24 hours" is our enterprise target for confirmed incidents, but in public docs we often soften to "as soon as practicable and within 48 hours" for non-contracted customers. 2) We avoid committing to regulator filings on customers' behalf. 3) For PII breaches, we escalate Legal immediately — timelines shift based on regulator rules.
Ava (Legal): +1 to Sara. Also add a line: "Redwood will coordinate with the customer's designated legal contact and provide reasonable assistance for legally-required notifications." Keeps responsibilities clear.
Mike (Customer Success): If this goes to Acme, I'll own the notification channel and confirm their primary security and legal contacts. Also note: if they want a SLA-mandated timeline in contract, that needs Sales + Legal signoff (and likely Dedicated/Private deployment conversation).
Emma (Sales): Helpful — can you also provide a short one-paragraph version for the SIG sheet? Need something <=3 lines.
Sara (Security): Use this short blurb: "Redwood notifies designated customer contacts as soon as practicable and within 24–48 hours of confirming a material security incident. We provide an initial summary within 72 hours and a technical report within 30 days; we assist with regulatory notifications as required."
Jordan (Solutions Eng): For the POC doc, also mention forensic basics: we can share IOCs, relevant logs, and mitigations; for full packet captures or sensitive logs we may redact customer-sensitive third-party data.
Sara (Security): And add: we may engage a third-party forensic vendor at Redwood's discretion; costs and scope will be covered per contract for enterprise customers.
Emma (Sales): Perfect. I'll drop the long snippet + short blurb into the SIG response and attach the sample post-incident report template. Mike, I'll loop you in on the Acme thread.
Mike (Customer Success): Got it — ping me @channel when ready and I'll follow up with their contacts. :thumbsup:
IR Bot: Incident runbook link: <https://internal.redwood/runbooks/incident-response> (for internal use only)
Ava (Legal): One more: if customer asks for guaranteed regulator notification windows in the contract, escalate to Legal — we need to confirm insurance/contract exposure.
Emma (Sales): Thanks all. Filing these into the presales kit now. Jordan, can you add the short blurb to the presales snippets doc?
Jordan (Solutions Eng): On it. I'll update the doc and version it. :white_check_mark:
Sara (Security): Happy to review the final wording before you send to Acme.
Emma (Sales): Appreciate it — will tag you.
